data_plan: TSLA 15-minute bars, US regular session only (09:30–16:00 America/New_York). The RD programme's current operative panels (forex_cross41, crypto30) do not carry US equities, so the run must source a provenance-verified TSLA 15-minute panel and state the exact source, panel and date range it used, applying walk-forward folds per programme convention. Because the declared frequency is at most one trade per session, the OOS split alone needs >= 200 sessions with a qualifying close to reach the bar's 200-trade minimum; if the sourced panel cannot support that, the run reports the shortfall honestly instead of relaxing the bar. The run is a separate, later step and is NOT part of the declaring PR.

declared_conventions.position_sizing: NOT STATED in the source video — no position size, % risk or $ risk appears anywhere in it. Declared convention: sizing is not part of this family's identity; if the candidate ever reaches forward testing it inherits the fleet-standard decided risk package (FWD-006) unchanged.
declared_conventions.re_entry: NOT STATED in the source video. Declared convention: at most one trade per session per instrument — the range is by construction the session's first two candles, so the setup exists once per session.
declared_conventions.session_end_exit: NOT STATED in the source video ('just let the trade play out' is all it says). Declared convention: exit at the session close if neither stop nor target has triggered, and never hold overnight — this is a day-trading strategy whose setup is defined by one session's open.
declared_conventions.tp_unit_and_instrument: The source says 'ten points' without naming an instrument or a unit in words. Declared v1 scope from the video's own evidence: the chart shown throughout — including at the 'ten points' moment — is TSLA 15-minute, with a target box reading 9.70 at that moment, so v1 reads 10 points as 10 dollars on TSLA and tests TSLA only. The secondhand 'ES futures points' reading has no support in the video itself and is OUT OF SCOPE for v1; testing it would require its own declaration.

evaluation_bar.costs: programme cost model AND a 2x-cost shadow run, both must pass; exits simulated under the harness convention (entry at the breakout candle's close -> position managed from the next bar onward, stop-before-target worst case within any bar)
evaluation_bar.judgement: OOS only; parameters are frozen by this declaration — nothing is selected in-sample
evaluation_bar.multiple_testing: Bonferroni against the programme trial floor at run time (floor >= 1980 trials as of 2026-11-15 and rising; the run must state the floor it used)

hypothesis: On TSLA's 15-minute chart, a candle CLOSE beyond the first-two-candles (opening) range of the US session, traded in the direction of the break with the stop at the opposite end of the range and a fixed 10-point target, wins often enough — the creator's framing is small wins at a high win rate offsetting occasional full-range losses — to clear the programme bar net of costs.
promotion_path: Passing the bar makes this a forward-test CANDIDATE only, under the Phase-3 forward protocol (>=100 trades AND >=8 weeks on demo). Nothing here authorises live trading.

rules.entry_long: the first 15-minute candle after the two range candles that CLOSES above the range high; entry at that candle's close
rules.entry_short: mirror: the first 15-minute candle after the two range candles that CLOSES below the range low; entry at that candle's close
rules.entry_window: the qualifying close must occur on a candle closing by 15:45 ET, so at least one bar remains to manage the position; no qualifying close in the window means no trade that session
rules.frequency: at most ONE trade per session — the first qualifying close only; no re-entry the same session (declared convention, see declared_conventions.re_entry)
rules.instrument: TSLA only in v1 (see declared_conventions.tp_unit_and_instrument); 15-minute bars; US regular session 09:30–16:00 America/New_York
rules.no_lookahead: the range uses only the session's first two candles; an entry uses only its own candle's close; stop and target are evaluated from the next bar onward
rules.parameters_fixed: TP_POINTS=10 — no other variants are authorised under this declaration; trying variants means new declarations and a higher trial count
rules.range: high = max high and low = min low of the FIRST TWO 15-minute candles of the session (09:30–09:45 and 09:45–10:00 ET); a session whose first two candles are missing from the data, or produce a zero-height range, produces no signals
rules.session_end: if neither stop nor target has triggered by the session close (16:00 ET), exit at the session close; positions are never held overnight under this declaration (declared convention, see declared_conventions.session_end_exit)
rules.stop: the opposite end of the range — range low for a long, range high for a short — as stated in the source
rules.target: entry price + 10 points (long) / entry price - 10 points (short); points read as dollars on TSLA in v1 (see declared_conventions.tp_unit_and_instrument)

The creator's '81% win rate' is an unverified marketing claim and is treated as such: it bought this family a pre-declared test, nothing more.
